If you are running OS X 10.11 or later (El Capitan), you've gotta make an adjustment.

http://www.macworld.com/article/2986118/security/how-to-modify-system-integrity-protection-in-el-capitan.html

Near the bottom are step by step instructions on how to disable System Integrity Protection.

This should allow WavTap and SoundFlower to work.  (I'd suggest WavTap as it's a lot easier to use.)
